description.p: SVN Server Admin provides a graphical interface for system administrators managing Subversion (SVN) repositories on Linux servers.

ul.li: Create, delete, inspect, and hot-copy repositories
Manage users, groups, and fine-grained path permissions (authz)
Edit and enable/disable all 9 SVN hook scripts with syntax highlighting
Evaluate effective access for any user on any path
Configure SMTP outgoing mail profiles with live test send
Schedule automated backup and verification jobs
Monitor and control the svnserve daemon

screenshot.caption: Repository manager with access control editor

description.p: Initial release with full repository administration, access control, hook management, SMTP profiles, job scheduling, and service control.
